title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Rate and Promotion Sheet
content:
Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing is offered in six plans: Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12, Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18, Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 and Ridgeline Low-Payment 144. This sheet gives each plan's annual rates, the kind and length of its promotion, and the rate figures that apply around that promotion. Rates are annual percentage rates; the plan names in the column heads omit the common "Ridgeline" prefix.

## Rate and promotion figures

| | Same-As-Cash 12 | Same-As-Cash 18 | Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Fixed-Rate 60 | Fixed-Rate 120 | Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kind of promotion | Deferred interest | Deferred interest | Zero-APR equal payment | None | None | None |
| Promotional period from the funded date (calendar months) | 12 | 18 | 24 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Purchase APR (rate on the balance outside any promotion) | 26.99% | 26.99% | 0.00% | 6.99% | 9.99% | 11.99% |
| Re-amortization term after a deferred-interest promotion (months) | 48 | 48 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Consecutive statement periods ending delinquent that forfeit a zero-APR promotion | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Forfeit APR (from the next statement period after forfeiture) | 26.99% | 26.99% | 17.99% | 6.99% | 9.99% | 11.99% |
| Autopay APR discount (while autopay is enrolled) | 0.00% | 0.00% | 0.00% | 0.25% | 0.25% | 0.50% |

## Reading the figures

- A promotional period of 0 months means the plan carries no promotion; a re-amortization term of 0 means the plan has no deferred-interest balance to re-amortize.
- A forfeiture count of 0 means no forfeiture applies to that plan, and on those plans the forfeit APR shown is simply the purchase APR.
- The autopay APR discount is a reduction of the effective APR while autopay is enrolled; a plan showing 0.00% gives no autopay rate reduction.

## Interest bases common to every plan

| Basis | All six plans |
|---|---|
| How monthly interest is figured | One twelfth of the effective APR applied to the balance at the start of the statement period |
| How deferred interest is figured | Monthly accrual at the purchase APR on each promotional statement period's starting balance |

**Accounts without a promotion.** The description of how monthly interest is figured, and of the autopay discount as a reduction of the effective APR while autopay is enrolled, is that of the base interest rules. For an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the monthly interest is governed by the current monthly interest basis: the balance carried on the posting day, the annual rate and the manner that basis sets out.

## Questions this sheet answers

**Which plans carry a promotion?** Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 and Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18 carry a deferred-interest promotion of 12 and 18 months; Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 carries a zero-APR equal payment promotion of 24 months. Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 and Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 carry none.

**What rate does a Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 account carry if its promotion is forfeited?** 17.99%, once 2 consecutive statement periods have ended delinquent.

**Which plan has the largest autopay rate reduction?** Ridgeline Low-Payment 144, at 0.50%.
